items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: a lot of commercials that have a female vocalist imitating Sheryl Crow

ctx.x: turtle music and that’s really an aquatic turtle.” I thought she was joking. I said, “Well you had it in an terrarium, you faked me out here, I thought it was a land turtle. She was serious. I had to change the music and somehow figure out what she meant by water turtle music.

It’s really fascinating to watch the trends that commercials seem to jump on. Like I’ve been noticing lately a lot of commercials that have a female vocalist imitating Sheryl Crow. And this seems to be the hot thing. And I wonder how long that will last, until something else comes along.

Well it’s because one of them worked. And that’s the big thing in the media these days. Anything that works, let’s just do that because it’s already proved itself. And it can be frustrating when you’re composing because it puts you in a very narrow box. But it’s a gig.
